def count_winning_flips(s, w, c):
    """Count the winning first moves in the following coin-flipping game.

    A row of n coins (1 <= n <= 300) is described by the string s, where
    s[i] is 'H' (heads) or 'T' (tails) for cell i, 0 <= i < n.  Two players
    alternate moves; a player who cannot move loses.

    A move is a set F of cells to flip (toggle H<->T), chosen as follows:
      * let i = max(F); cell i must currently show 'H' (it flips to 'T');
      * F may contain at most c further cells (so 1 <= |F| <= c + 1),
        and every other cell t in F must satisfy i - w <= t < i;
      * the other cells of F may currently show either face - flipping
        toggles them regardless.
    All cells in F are toggled simultaneously.  Two moves are the same
    move if and only if they flip the same set F.

    Parameters: 1 <= w <= 8 and 0 <= c <= 3 (both ints).

    Return the number of distinct moves available to the player to move
    from position s that lead to a position from which the OPPONENT loses
    under optimal play by both sides.  If the player to move loses with
    best play (in particular if s has no 'H' at all), return 0.

    >>> count_winning_flips("HH", 1, 1)
    1
    >>> count_winning_flips("THHTH", 2, 2)
    1
    >>> count_winning_flips("HTHHTTHH", 3, 2)
    4
    """
